class.name: VMLModLoader
class.brief_description: VortarisModLoader engine singleton (`VML`). Namespaced id registry, unified content database, declarative hooks, and runtime mod lifecycle.
class.description:
Registered at engine start (SCENE level) before any autoload, exposed to scripts as the `VML` singleton.
Content model: every piece of moddable content is addressed by a namespaced id `namespace:path` (Minecraft ResourceLocation style, e.g. `game:units.knight`). Mods stack above the base layer; a later-loaded mod wins when two providers claim the same id (override arbitration by priority, then explicit flag, then mod id).
Three layers: - Routing: id → winning physical file ([method has], [method resolve], [method get_data], [method get_resource], [method instantiate]). - Database: an in-memory repository that can preload every data id for O(1) lookups ([method preload_database], [method get_all], [method set_data], [method delete_data]). - Hooks: declarative event points, each a namespaced id ([method add_hook], [method invoke_hook], [method emit_hook], [method check_hook]).
Mod lifecycle: mods are discovered under `res://mods-unpacked/` and `user://vml/mods/` (zip-installed). [method enable_mod]/[method disable_mod] toggle them at runtime; [method install_mod_from_zip] extracts a zip mod transactionally.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: True once the routing layer and initial mod scan are built.

method.name: has
method.description: True if `id` resolves to any provider.

method.name: resolve
method.description: Physical path of the winning provider for `id` ("" if unknown).

method.name: get_data
method.description: Load by id: .json/.csv parse to Dictionary/Array, everything else returns the Resource. Hit the in-memory database when it is populated.

method.name: get_resource
method.description: Load a Resource by id (scenes, scripts, textures, fonts, audio).

method.name: instantiate
method.description: Instantiate a PackedScene resolved by id, returning a Node.

method.name: register
method.description: Explicitly map `id` to `path`; beats implicit providers at equal priority.

method.name: unregister
method.description: Remove an explicit registration.

method.name: list_ids
method.description: All ids as { namespace: PackedStringArray }, optionally filtered by prefix.

method.name: list_namespaces
method.description: Every content namespace currently indexed.

method.name: preload_database
method.description: Preload every data id (or all ids in "all" mode) into the in-memory database.

method.name: reload_database
method.description: Clear and re-preload the database per the current mode.

method.name: get_all
method.description: Loaded database entries as { canonical_id: value }.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Overwrite a database entry in place (emits [signal database_entry_changed]).

method.name: delete_data
method.description: Remove a database entry (lookups fall back to the file).

method.name: get_database_mode
method.description: "data" (default), "all", or "off".

method.name: set_database_mode
method.description: Switch database mode and reload.

method.name: finish_startup
method.description: Instantiate every enabled mod's mod_main.gd. Call once from a bootstrap autoload's _ready.

method.name: add_hook
method.description: Register a Callable on a hook point. Called from a mod_main it is attributed to that mod automatically.

method.name: remove_hook
method.description: Remove one handler.

method.name: invoke_hook
method.description: Pipeline: each handler receives (current, ...args) and returns the rewritten value; the last value is returned. Handlers run by priority.

method.name: emit_hook
method.description: Fire-and-forget broadcast to all handlers.

method.name: check_hook
method.description: Predicate: true when no handler vetoes (any handler returning false short-circuits).

method.name: register_hook_point
method.description: Declare a hook point for docs/editor discovery.

method.name: list_hooks
method.description: Registered hooks as { hook_id: { count, mods } }.

method.name: list_hook_points
method.description: Declared hook points as { hook_id: { description, arg_types } }.

method.name: get_mod_ids
method.description: Every discovered mod id (valid or not).

method.name: get_load_order
method.description: Dependency-sorted load order of valid mods (base excluded).

method.name: get_mod_errors
method.description: Human-readable errors for a mod (missing deps, cycle, bad manifest).

method.name: is_mod_enabled
method.description: True when the mod's content is stacked in the registry.

method.name: is_mod_loaded
method.description: True when the mod's mod_main is instantiated.

method.name: enable_mod
method.description: Activate a mod: stack content, instantiate mod_main, register hooks.

method.name: disable_mod
method.description: Deactivate a mod (refused while active mods depend on it).

method.name: load_mod
method.description: Runtime load: alias of enable_mod.

method.name: unload_mod
method.description: Runtime unload: alias of disable_mod.

method.name: install_mod_from_zip
method.description: Transactionally extract a zip mod into user://vml/mods and activate it. Returns an Error code.

method.name: uninstall_mod
method.description: Remove an installed (user://) mod entirely. Returns an Error code.

method.name: reload_resources
method.description: Dev hot reload: re-scan affected mods and refresh their database entries.

method.name: get_content_roots
method.description: Directories the hot-reloader should watch (base layer + enabled mods).

method.name: start_hot_reload
method.description: Start a polling hot-reloader node (dev builds / editor).

method.name: rescan
method.description: Full re-discovery and rebuild of the routing layer + database.

signal.name: database_loaded
signal.description: Emitted after a full database preload.

signal.name: database_entry_changed
signal.description: A database entry was rewritten or removed.

signal.name: registry_rebuilt
signal.description: The routing layer was rebuilt (rescan / hot reload).
